text:
Hey! I did my citizenship process in November last year and got it Feb this year.
At some point in December they asked us to bring the originals we presented when opening the case (wedding certificate, my birth certificate, criminal records and single certificate). They saw them, made copies and send us home 😅
Regarding the letter, I wrote a very passionate one in English (because they said I could) and when we went to drop it they said it had to be in Hebrew 🙄🙄 so my partner wrote something like: we open the case X date, weve been together X time and I would like to apply to citizenship to continue building my life and family here (wrote it on my behalf) and i signed it 😅
